title: Constructible etale modules for discrete Noetherian coefficients
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\Lambda$ a discrete commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. On its small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], write $\underline\Lambda_X$ for the constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and use sheaves of $\underline\Lambda_X$-modules and their linear morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Such a module sheaf $F$ is constructible if, for every affine open $U\subseteq X$, there is a finite partition $U=\coprod_{a=1}^n Z_a$ into constructible locally closed subschemes: their underlying subsets are constructible in $U$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset], pairwise disjoint, and cover $U$. For each inclusion $i_a:Z_a\to X$, the inverse-image restriction $i_a^{-1}F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] must admit an etale covering $\{V_{ab}\to Z_a\}_b$ and isomorphisms $(i_a^{-1}F)|_{V_{ab}}\cong\underline{M_{ab}}_{V_{ab}}$ of module sheaves, where $M_{ab}$ are finitely generated $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and the right side is the constant module sheaf. Finite generation refers to modules, and does not require their underlying sets to be finite. The constructible etale module category is the full subcategory on these sheaves.

Write $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for the full subcategory of the derived category of the ambient abelian category of all sheaves of $\underline\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] whose objects $K$ have constructible cohomology sheaves $H^q(K)$ for every integer $q$ and $H^q(K)=0$ outside some finite interval. No completeness condition is imposed.
